随着指挥官歇斯底里的咆哮，数千道足以贯穿小行星的高能激光束与反物质导弹，拖着耀眼的尾焰刺向那片占据了整个雷达屏幕的“粉毛狐娘”。然而，当硝烟散去，传回的画面让舰桥上的每一个人都感到了骨髓里的冰冷。
足以毁灭一支常规舰队的火力齐射，打在那巨大的身躯上，竟然连一点痕迹都没有留下。那些爆炸产生的火光，在她那如同粉色绸缎般的发丝映衬下，渺小得就像是夏天夜晚偶尔闪烁的几只萤火虫。林凤甚至连眨眼都没眨一下。她依然保持着那个慵懒的姿势，在真空中缓缓漂浮前行。
“啊啦？刚才是有什么东西在叮我不成？”
她的声音直接通过精神波动震荡着每一艘战舰的船壳，有一种刚刚睡醒般的困倦和好奇。
对于她来说，这支全副武装的警备舰队，不过是一群挡在路上的浮游生物。她根本没有减速，甚至懒得挥手去拍打，只是任由那庞大的身躯顺着惯性向前“飘”去。
砰、砰、砰……
绝望的碰撞开始了。位于前锋的数百艘护卫舰和驱逐舰，像是撞上了无形墙壁的飞鸟。它们引以为傲的合金装甲，在触碰到林凤那看似柔软的粉色尾巴尖端，或者是衣角飘带的瞬间，便像鸡蛋碰石头一样被挤压、扭曲、引爆。她只是简单的飘过，就将整支舰队像灰尘一样撞得支离破碎。
“喔？这个看起来……稍微精致一点呢。”
突然，林凤像是发现了什么有趣的小玩具，巨大的狐耳微微抖动。正在疯狂后撤的旗舰，突然被一片巨大的阴影笼罩。还没等舰长下达规避指令，一只遮天蔽日的玉手已经破开虚空，两根手指如同捏起一颗微尘般，精准而优雅地捏住了这艘长达数公里的泰坦级旗舰。剧烈的震动让舰桥内一片狼藉，重力系统彻底失效。舰长惊恐地抬头，透过全景视窗，他看到的不再是星空，而是林凤那张被放大了无数倍的、带着戏谑笑意的俏脸。
“小指挥官，只有你……是被允许留下的哦～♡”
林凤那双媚意横生的紫色眼眸微微弯起，随后，她做出了一个让所有人都意想不到的动作。
她并没有捏碎旗舰，而是用另一只手轻轻拉开了胸前那巨大的衣领。那是两座仿佛由洁白玉石雕琢而成的、绵延万里的柔软山峦。深不见底的乳沟散发着惊人的热量与香气，对于旗舰上的人来说，那是最温柔也是最恐怖的监狱。
“去吧，乖乖待在里面，别乱动哦。”
随着她手指的松开，旗舰“荣耀号”在引力的牵引下，径直坠入了那深邃的乳沟之中。舰体与那两团硕大无比的乳肉发生了接触。
“唔……稍微有点凉凉的，还挺舒服。”
林凤满足地哼了一声，双手在胸侧用力向内一挤。 那两座巨大的乳峰瞬间合拢，将旗舰死死地夹在了中间。恐怖的挤压力让旗舰的龙骨发出了悲鸣，但又恰到好处地没有立刻被压扁。在这一刻，这艘代表着文明最高科技结晶的旗舰，彻底沦为了这只巨大狐娘胸口的一枚别针。
translation: “The guard fleet has engaged! Open all batteries! Fire! Full fire coverage!”\\nWith the commander's hysterical roar, thousands of high-energy laser beams and anti-matter missiles, capable of piercing asteroids, stabbed with dazzling tail flames toward the “pink fox-girl” occupying the entire radar screen. However, when the smoke cleared, the returned images sent a chill into everyone's bones.\\nA volley powerful enough to annihilate a conventional fleet hit that massive body without leaving so much as a scratch. The flickers produced by those explosions, set against her hair like pink silk, were as tiny as fireflies on a summer night. Linfeng didn't even blink. She remained in that lazy posture, drifting slowly through the vacuum.\\n“Ara? Was something just nipping at me?”\\nHer voice vibrated directly through the hull of every ship via mental waves, with the sleepiness and curiosity of someone who just woke up.\\nTo her, this fully armed guard fleet was nothing more than a group of plankton in her path. She didn't slow down, didn't even bother to swat them aside, simply allowing her massive body to drift forward by inertia.\\nBang, bang, bang...\\nThe desperate collisions began. Hundreds of corvettes and destroyers at the front were like birds hitting an invisible wall. Their proud alloy armor, the moment it touched the tip of Linfeng’s seemingly soft pink tail or her flowing ribbons, was crushed, twisted, and detonated like an egg against a stone. She simply drifted past, crushing the entire fleet like dust.\\n“Oh? This one looks... a bit more refined.”\\nSuddenly, as if discovering an interesting little toy, Linfeng's massive fox ears twitched slightly. The flagship, frantically retreating, was suddenly shrouded in a giant shadow. Before the captain could issue an evasive command, a hand that blotted out the sun tore through the void. Two fingers, like picking up a speck of dust, precisely and elegantly pinched the titan-class flagship several kilometers long. Violent tremors left the bridge in shambles, and the gravity systems failed completely. The captain looked up in horror; through the panoramic window, he no longer saw space, but Linfeng's face, magnified countless times, with a playful, mocking smile.\\n“Little commander, only you... are allowed to stay~♡”\\nLinfeng's enchanting purple eyes curved slightly, and then she performed an action that no one expected.\\nShe didn't crush the flagship. Instead, with her other hand, she gently pulled open the giant collar at her chest. There lay two soft peaks stretching for thousands of leagues, as if carved from white jade. The bottomless cleavage radiated incredible heat and fragrance, making it the gentlest yet most terrifying prison for those aboard the flagship.\\n“Go on, stay in there properly, don't move around.”\\nAs her fingers released, the flagship 'Glory' fell straight into that deep cleavage under the pull of gravity. The hull made contact with those two immense mounds of flesh.\\n“Mmm... it’s a bit cool, actually feels quite nice.”\\nLinfeng gave a satisfied hum and squeezed her hands inward at her sides. Those two giant breasts instantly clamped shut, trapping the flagship tightly in between. The terrifying pressure made the flagship's keel groan, but it was just enough not to flatten it instantly. At this moment, the flagship representing the crowning technological achievement of their civilization had been reduced to a mere brooch on this giant fox-girl’s chest.

original:
收到命令后，希瞳不耐烦地咋了一下舌。她手中正把玩着的一颗土著星球，被她像丢垃圾一样随手甩向了深空——那颗倒霉的星球在飞行过程中撞上了一片小行星带，瞬间炸成了一朵绚烂的烟花，但希瞳连看都懒得看一眼。
“真麻烦……明明刚找到一点感觉。”
虽然嘴上抱怨，但作为帝国舰娘的服从性还是让她动了起来。空间折跃的光芒一闪，下一秒，希瞳的身影便出现在了边境星域。
当她看到远处那个粉色的巨大身影时，金色的瞳孔微微收缩了一下。（没有帝国识别码，没有能量回路反应……只是一个体积大一点的野生生物吗？）
“作为野生巨娘来说，长得倒是不错。正好抓回去当个宠物。”
希瞳冷笑一声，甚至没有完全展开战斗姿态。希瞳漫不经心地抬起手，掌心瞬间凝聚起数枚幽蓝色的反物质能量弹。这可是足以瞬间蒸发一支联合舰队的火力，她觉得用来打“招呼”已经足够给面子了。
能量弹拖着长长的尾焰，精准地轰向了林凤的面门。 然而，预想中的爆炸和惨叫并没有出现。希瞳愣住了。 那几枚足以贯穿地壳的能量弹，在距离林凤鼻尖还有几千公里的地方，像是撞上了一堵看不见的墙壁连涟漪都没有泛起，就这样无声无息地……消失了。
林凤那双一直半眯着的紫色眼眸，缓缓睁开了一条缝。她甚至没有改变原本慵懒漂浮的姿势，只是微微侧过头，看向了这边飘在空中的希瞳。
“哎呀……没想到呢。”
“小人的文明也会豢养比他们还要强大不知道多少倍的存在么？“明明拥有能够将星间万物都当做玩物的身躯，却依旧自甘堕落戴上项圈充当虫子的看家犬……可真是委屈你了呢。”“但既然你已经攻击我了，可就别怪我还手咯～”
林凤嘴角的笑意加深了，那是猎人看着落入陷阱的猎物时特有的温柔。
希瞳还没来得及反驳，就看到林凤轻轻抬起了一根手指，只是简单的指尖轻点。刹那间，原本漆黑冰冷的宇宙真空，被染成了刺眼的赤红色。 火球。 最基础的、毫无花哨的火球，但是是那种数量完全无法计算。
“这种东西——！” 希瞳下意识地撑起护盾，试图嘲笑这种原始的攻击手段。但下一秒，她的脸色变了。 第一颗火球撞上护盾时，她感觉像被一颗恒星正面撞击。 紧接着是第二颗、第三颗、第一万颗……希瞳的视野瞬间被无尽的烈焰吞没。她引以为傲的绝对防御在这一波火球术面前，脆弱得像是一层保鲜膜，仅仅坚持了不到三秒就宣告破碎。
不知过了多久，攻击的频率慢慢降了下来。她在刻意控制节奏——就像是把猎物玩弄到半死之后的悠闲。林凤一边漫不经心地用几颗巨型火球将希瞳死死压制在原地，一边优雅地飘近，居高临下地看着狼狈不堪的希瞳。
“虽然说我并不介意让你给这些小虫子们陪葬，但我还是挺乐意饶你一命的。毕竟，同类很难得嘛～”
林凤伸出巨大的手指，轻轻挑起希瞳那已经满是灰尘和伤痕的下巴，强迫她抬起头。
“只要你愿意求饶～怎么样？很划算的交易吧？”
希瞳剧烈地喘息着，金色的竖瞳因为剧痛和屈辱而颤抖，但依然死死地盯着眼前这个恐怖的狐娘。
“哈？……我对这些虫子们自我介绍的时候……你没听见么？咳咳……” 希瞳咬着牙，嘴角溢出一丝鲜血，试图维持最后的尊严，“我可是……御月家的希瞳……”
“啧啧……看来还没听懂呢。”
林凤遗憾地摇了摇头，手指微微用力，指尖燃起一缕更加纯粹的金色火焰，以此作为警告。
“那就重新自我介绍一下吧——”
在这无尽的星空背景下，林凤的声音如同宣判命运的神谕：
“林凤。来自异界的旅者。” “以及——你往后余生都要用你的生命、用你的一切去侍奉的……主人。”
translation: After receiving the order, Hitomi clicked her tongue impatiently. An aboriginal planet she was playing with in her hand was casually tossed into deep space like trash—the unlucky planet struck an asteroid belt in flight and instantly exploded into a brilliant firework, but Hitomi didn't even bother to glance back.\\n\"How troublesome... I was just starting to get a feel for it.\"\\nAlthough complaining, her obedience as an Imperial Shipgirl made her move. A flash of light from space fold, and the next second, Hitomi's figure appeared in the border star region.\\nWhen she saw that giant pink figure in the distance, her golden pupils contracted slightly. (No Imperial ID, no energy circuit reaction... is it just a slightly larger wild creature?)\\n\"For a wild Giantess, she looks quite good. I'll just catch her and keep her as a pet.\"\\nHitomi sneered, not even fully unfolding her combat stance. Hitomi casually lifted her hand, and several blue-colored antimatter energy balls instantly condensed in her palm. This was enough firepower to instantly vaporize a joint fleet; she felt it was enough to give \"face\" to use it as a \"greeting.\"\\nEnergy balls trailed long flame tails, accurately booming toward Linfeng's face. However, the expected explosion and screams did not appear. Hitomi was stunned. Those few energy balls, enough to pierce through a planetary crust, seemed to have hit an invisible wall thousands of kilometers away from Linfeng's nose without even causing a ripple, and vanished... just like that.\\nLinfeng's purple eyes, which had been half-squinted, slowly opened a crack. She didn't even change her originally lazy floating posture, merely tilted her head slightly and looked at Hitomi floating in the air.\\n\"Oh my... I didn't expect it.\"\\n\"Does the tiny people's civilization also keep beings who are countless times more powerful than them?\"\\n\"Clearly possessing a body that could treat everything in the stars as playthings, yet still willing to degenerate and wear a collar to serve as a watchdog for insects... it must be quite humiliating for you.\"\\n\"But since you've already attacked me, don't blame me for fighting back~\"\\nThe smile at the corner of Linfeng's mouth deepened; it was the specific tenderness of a hunter looking at prey that had fallen into a trap.\\nBefore Hitomi could refute, she saw Linfeng gently lift a finger, merely a simple tap of the fingertip. In an instant, the originally black and cold space vacuum was dyed a startling crimson. Fireballs. The most basic, unadorned fireballs, but in a number completely beyond calculation.\\n\"This kind of thing—!\" Hitomi subconsciously propped up a shield, attempting to mock such a primitive attack. But the next second, her expression changed. When the first fireball hit the shield, she felt as if she had been hit head-on by a star. \\nImmediately following were the second, third, ten-thousandth... Hitomi's vision was instantly engulfed by endless flames. Her proud absolute defense was as fragile as a piece of cling wrap before this wave of fireball magic, lasting less than three seconds before shattering.\\nAfter an unknown amount of time, the frequency of the attacks slowly slowed down. She was deliberately controlling the rhythm—like the leisure of playing with prey until it's half-dead. While carelessly suppressing Hitomi in place with several giant fireballs, Linfeng elegantly floated closer, looking down from above at the battered Hitomi.\\n\"Although I don't mind letting you be buried with these little insects, I'm still quite willing to spare your life. After all, it's rare to find one of the same kind~\"\\nLinfeng extended a giant finger, gently lifting Hitomi's chin, which was already full of dust and scars, forcing her to look up.\\n\"As long as you're willing to beg for mercy~ how about it? It's a very fair deal, isn't it?\"\\nHitomi breathed heavily, her golden slit pupils trembling from pain and humiliation, but still staring deathly at the terrifying fox girl before her.\\n\
A Punch for the Smug Pink Fox

original:
一切发生得都很突然，也很……儿戏。
也许是长期被当作玩物积攒的怨气，也许只是单纯的脑回路短路。在那个普通的午后，维持着常人大小的希瞳，面无表情地看着眼前正凑过来想要调戏她的林凤，鬼使神差地挥出了拳头。
“砰！”
一声清脆又略带空洞的闷响。 仿佛敲在了一个熟透的好瓜上。
空气凝固了三秒。
林凤愣住了。她两只手立刻捂住脑袋顶上被敲的地方，整个人缩了一下。头顶那对粉色的狐狸耳朵瞬间变成了“飞机耳”，死死地向后压去。 她抬起头，那双桃花眼里泛起了一层薄薄的水雾，脸颊气鼓鼓地成了包子，看起来竟然……意外地有点可爱？
“你敲我头……” 林凤的声音里带着一丝不可置信，还有显而易见的委屈。 “很痛的哎！而且会长不高的你知不知道！”
希瞳收回手，依然板着那张三无扑克脸，冷冷地说道：“手滑。谁让你凑过来的。”
“唔……气死我了！气死我了！” 林凤像个被抢了糖果的小女孩一样在原地跺了跺脚，她恶狠狠地瞪了希瞳一眼。
“我要还手！我现在就要敲回来！”
话音未落，林凤的身影凭空消失。 还没等希瞳反应过来，天空……变色了。
原本湛蓝的天空瞬间被一片漫无边际的粉色取代——那是林凤瞬间巨大化后的皮肤。希瞳僵硬地抬起头，看到了一幕让她后悔刚才那随手一敲的景象。在大气层之外，那张刚刚还因为委屈而气鼓鼓的脸庞，此刻已经变得比月球还要巨大。林凤依然鼓着脸颊，一只手捂着刚才被敲的头顶，另一只手却握成了足以覆盖半个大洲的巨拳。 她带着一副“我很生气、后果很严重”的表情，控制着那只巨拳，从外太空向着地表——也就是希瞳所在的位置，狠狠砸来。
“这叫——礼、尚、往、来！”
那个粉色的巨拳摩擦着大气层燃起了熊熊烈火，像是一颗灭世的陨石，带着毁灭一切的气势落下。
“等……你管这叫‘敲回来’？！” 希瞳那万年不变的冰山脸终于崩不住了，眼角疯狂抽搐。
轰隆————！！！
没有给她吐槽的时间，巨拳落下。 地壳像是被重锤砸中的饼干一样瞬间崩碎，冲击波横扫了整个半球，海洋被瞬间蒸发，山脉被夷为平地。整颗星球都在这一拳的威力下发出了痛苦的呻吟，彻底偏离了原本的公转轨道。
尘埃落定。 原本繁华的大陆板块中心，出现了一个深不见底的、巨大的拳印深坑。
在那深坑的最中心，灰头土脸、衣衫褴褛的希瞳狼狈地躺在坑底。而肇事者——那个巨大的粉毛狐娘，正蹲在大气层外，用手指戳着这个深坑，脸上带着大仇得报的满足笑容
“哼！扯平了！”
translation:
Everything happened very suddenly, and very... childishly.
Perhaps it was resentment accumulated from being treated as a plaything for so long, or perhaps just a brain circuit short-circuiting. On that ordinary afternoon, Hitomi, maintaining normal human size, expressionlessly looked at Linfeng who was leaning in close trying to tease her, and as if possessed, threw a punch.
"Bang!"
A crisp and slightly hollow thud. Like knocking on a ripe melon.
The air froze for three seconds.
Linfeng was stunned. She immediately clutched the knocked spot atop her head with both hands, flinching back. The pink fox ears on her head instantly turned into "airplane ears," pinned flat against her head. She looked up, a thin mist welling in her peach-blossom eyes, her cheeks puffed into buns in fury, looking... surprisingly cute?
"You hit my head..." Linfeng's voice carried a hint of disbelief, along with unmistakable grievance. "That really hurt! And do you know that stunts my growth?!"
Hitomi withdrew her hand, still maintaining her deadpan poker face, and said coldly: "My hand slipped. Who told you to lean in so close?"
"Mmmgh... You make me so mad! So mad!" Linfeng stomped her feet on the spot like a little girl whose candy had been stolen, glaring fiercely at Hitomi.
"I'm going to hit back! I'm going to knock you back right now!"
Before the words fell, Linfeng's figure vanished into thin air. Before Hitomi could react, the sky... changed color.
The originally azure sky was instantly replaced by a boundless expanse of pink—that was Linfeng's skin after she instantly grew to colossal size. Hitomi stiffly lifted her head, beholding a sight that made her regret that casual knock from earlier. Outside the atmosphere, that face—which had just been puffed up in grievance—had now grown larger than the moon. Linfeng was still puffing her cheeks, one hand clutching the knocked spot on her head, while the other clenched into a gigantic fist large enough to cover half a continent. With an expression that said "I am furious, and the consequences will be dire," she guided that colossal fist down from outer space toward the surface—directly at Hitomi's position.
"This is called—give-and-take!"
The pink giant fist ignited with blazing flames against the atmosphere, descending with the apocalyptic momentum of a world-ending meteorite.
"Wait... You call this 'knocking back'?!" Hitomi's perpetual iceberg face finally broke, the corners of her eyes twitching wildly.
Rumble————!!!
Giving her no time to complain, the giant fist crashed down. The planetary crust shattered instantly like a biscuit struck by a sledgehammer. The shockwave swept across the entire hemisphere, oceans vaporized instantly, and mountain ranges were flattened into plains. The entire planet groaned in agony under the force of this punch, completely knocked out of its original orbital path.
The dust settled. In the center of what was once a prosperous continental plate, a bottomless, gigantic fist-shaped crater had appeared.
At the very center of that deep crater lay Hitomi, battered, dusty, and in tatters, lying miserably at the bottom. And the culprit—that gigantic pink-haired fox girl—was crouching outside the atmosphere, poking the crater with her finger, a satisfied grin of sweet revenge on her face.
"Hmph! Now we're even!"

original:
“你的意思是说……想要我为你的帝国提供一艘舰船，而那艘舰船就是我的身体，对么？”
你抬起头来仰望着林凤的面容，而她则是满脸不悦的俯视着那艘你所在的帝国目前为止最为巨大的太空战舰——她正因你打扰了她用星球爱抚自己身体的行为感到不悦。
“是的……帝国财政与目前的工业能力无法在短期内组织起一支足够防御外敌的舰队，而我们现在还有许多的威胁要应对……”

但随着石子飞起，人们迅速察觉到异样，少女的玩心渐起带来的后果便是——吐息强度的飞速升级。一开始的和煦春风仅在几秒后就迎来了大变样，温暖的感觉被增强的风速驱散，地面上跪拜的人群处了几个还在执迷不悟，其他已经开始再一次的逃向封闭的场所，肉体的自自信被少女摧毁，只能再一次的寄托那脆弱的人造物，那些来不及逃进室内的也不得不紧紧抓住路边固定的栏杆，只有这样才勉强能在暴风中稳定住身子。

经历少女两次来自口腔内吐息的城市，再一次被少女口水形成的雾气笼罩，这次在口里储蓄许久的气体，哪怕穿过大气层都没削弱分毫，随着吐息的方向拍打着城市的雾气，让人们失去了视野。真个城市化作灰暗雾都，人们一瞬间变成了无头苍蝇，除了四处乱窜之外，什么也做不到了。

§Y“轰轰轰轰———！！！”§!

双唇分开的距离逐渐增大，天空从灰色逐渐转为红色，随着第一个人的失手离地，人们开始意识到仅凭自己的肉身已经无法抵挡如此狂风了。越来越多的人被卷上天空，幸运地还有享受高空美景的机会，另一些不幸的小人最开始只是还没来的及躲避而狂风抓住脚踝拉倒，就像是顽童般，越来越强大的气流，先是用钢铁刮破了他脆弱的肌肤，把他当做锤子一次次撞击车辆，随着水流汇集它的力道也越加野蛮，那少女的吐息对这“手上玩具”更加粗鲁，现在每次碰撞不只是流下红的一片，还留下一大片花白，坏掉的玩偶每一次甩起，里面的东西就像是棉花一样从破洞中掏出洒向四周。等皮囊都不完整，空扁的像是碎片一样从他指尖溜走，成为嵌入墙体上的烂泥，不过那最倒霉的人直接被这强风把身体按到墙上活生生地被挤爆，这样的场景，这样的惨状不断在城市中上演着。

全程怀着戏弄人类的心情操纵着这一切的少女，漂浮在近外太空的高空看着这戏剧性的一幕。她也尚未知道，自己吐息的极限到底在哪，按捺不住好奇心的她，摒弃最后一丝对小人的仁慈，放下工作要求有意的增大了吐息的强度，而这反映到脆弱的城市里，则是另一番景象了。

未固定的物品悉数升空，道路两旁的电线杆也未能幸免于难。低矮的平房有些已被掀掉房顶，滞留在地面的汽车与行人无一幸存，像是皮球一样被强风踢起，摔到墙上被强风按着层层磨碎，先是车前盖翘起，引擎被野蛮扯出，珍贵的零件被撒到到处都是，随后就是驾驶舱带着那如纸一般的小人，被搓成一团腥臭的铁球，最后连车后灯都被压碎，整个车体终于被淘气少女完全摧毁。

§r“真是抱歉呐”§!

少女看着这样的惨状，内心轻轻的向他们倒了声歉，但身体的动作却完全没有放松，反而张开嘴唇让吹出的吐息更强几分，就连高楼也即将抵挡不住这种级别的风速，摇摇晃晃的大楼好像下一刻就要倒塌，地面的平房已经完全飞上天空，郊区的田地甚至被整块整块地掀起，那些根成为他们之间的联系，这接连的田地飞起的景象如果被小人看到，或许会想起被狂风掀起的铁皮，然后明白哪怕是大地在少女力量下，不过是如纸一样轻薄，只能期望些原本属于田地的泥沙，在别的地方会堆积成一座新的山脉。让后人有地方建立这些逝者的丰碑。

再过几秒，那些人类最为精巧和骄傲的高楼也在少女的吐息下臣服了。但最致命的，莫过于从刻晴口中飞出的小抹唾液。这些半径几米十几米的唾液团，带着极高的动能撞向大楼，就像是撕碎枯叶，轻则把整个外墙撕碎，把里面的人们变成其包含的肉泥，重则整栋楼被粉碎，整栋楼在倾倒的过程中，被唾液团撕咬干净，就算是直接撞向地面，也能够击穿地表到达百米之深的地底，躲在地下室里的小人，也许能暂时躲过地面的暴风，却在一声巨响中看着天花板坍塌，那索命的鬼神给予他最后一丝绝望。

就当所有人都以为，自己就要在这少女温柔的吐息中暴死的时候，她却忽然停了下来。

在一切被她摧毁之前，她想最后欣赏一次她的作品——在自己嘴唇正前方的城市已经完全消失，就连地面也被掀起了一层除了那残存的泥沙，各色的岩盘已经尽数暴露在少女眼前，而距离较近的几个城市，只剩下数十栋孤独的高楼还在矗立着，坑坑洼洼的地面里面储存着少女口水如同琥珀一样闪耀，各色红泥和残存的城市颜色点缀其中让一切看起来没呢吗单调。

§r“感觉意外还不错嘛~”§!

只是吐息就把几十组城市组成的城市群完全摧毁，受灾地区更是遍布这个国家，现在她就要给这个自豪的作品点上最后一笔。

§Y“噗——！”§!

少女一下子将积存在肺中的空气全部吐到地上，滚烫的吐息吹过之处无一不被染成土色，就算躲在那些能防御核弹袭击的深埋地堡这一次也没能幸免。在她的周围城市最后一丝存在也小时化作以她为中心的圆弧状废墟，在这扇形边缘还能看到被吹碎的建筑，而在更远的彼方，那新形成的山脉，便是之前存在于少女唇下的城市。

§r“没想到你们早就同意了啊，抱歉刚刚玩的……推销的太开心了没有看见。最为道歉下次点名我来，只收你们半价哦~”§!

少女尽兴玩，装作才看到提示的样子，用手轻轻抵住自己发顶故作可爱的卖一个萌，随后就留下这个“杰作”消失在天边。
translation:
§r"Huu~~~~~"§!

She exhaled gently at first, giving them time. The warm breath felt like a spring breeze, evaporating the flood. Survivors worshipped her.

But as stones flew, the intensity rose. The breeze became a gale. People were blown away. The city became a gray fog of debris.

§Y"BOOM———!!!"§!

The sky turned red. People were lifted, smashed against walls, or crushed by air pressure. Like broken dolls, they were destroyed.

She increased the intensity. Cars flew like balls, engines torn out, drivers crushed. Skyscrapers swayed.

§r"So sorry."§!

She opened her mouth wider. Buildings flew, fields were lifted. The earth was as thin as paper.

Saliva droplets hit like cannonballs, tearing through buildings and penetrating deep underground. Bunkers collapsed.

She stopped to admire her work. The city was gone. Only bedrock and saliva pools remained.

§r"Looks unexpectedly nice~"§!

§Y"Puff——!"§!

She blew out the remaining air. The ground turned earth-colored. Deep bunkers failed. A fan-shaped wasteland remained.

§r"Oh, you already agreed? Sorry, I was having too much fun. Half price next time as an apology~"§!

She acted cute and left.

original:
§r看起来好美味啊……§!

看着地面大楼林立， 少女忍不住吞了几口口水，可惜因为这次的险种是吐息险，少女只好轻拍脸颊让自己从对城市味道的妄想中回过神来，理理衣服的衣角正式开始这次保险推销。

§r“那个大家好啊，我是[branch_office_owner.GetName]的推销员，希望大家购买我们公司的吐息险呢。”§!

少女的声音清脆而响亮让听到的人只感到如丝竹流入耳朵，少女较好的面容站到大街上也应该回头率不低。但人们看向她的表情只有惊慌，随后就像老鼠一样四而逃。

不过换个视角，人们从地面向上望去，看到少女白皙的脸蛋通过大气层外延，只是嘴唇轻轻的一张一合，就把方圆千里的云朵击散，从嘴里溢出一丝吐息穿过近千公里的大气层泼洒到大地上，人们只感受到一阵热浪带着一股好闻的味道在整个城市弥漫开来，细腻的口水雾在穿越大气层中几乎全部蒸腾，到地上只有绵密的水雾和阵阵微风，和冰冷的建筑外玻璃相接触一瞬间玻璃上就结出浓厚的水雾，哪怕这是少女讲话中携带的水汽都已经是这个城市一个月的降水了，蒸腾的水汽化作巨量的乌云在城市上集结下起滂沱大雨。

积水开始在城市里堆积，原本小人还有着一丝侥幸，想着只不过是别人一次小小吐息而已，能有什么威力，达到红色警报多少有点过头了吧？但转眼之间就有几个小人惊恐的发现积水已经到达脚腕，城市的泄洪设施对少女口水来说实在过于渺小，哪怕把抽水设施功率开到最大，机器的轰鸣声却被“口水”雨的声音掩盖，如果在这样下去整个国家都要被少女几次轻轻吐息的口水完全淹没，眼见的少女当然发现了，不过比起帮忙她第一刻想到的是不满。

§r“完全被乌云挡住了，看不到下面的情况，小人为什么要住在这种连说话都影响的星球上，这么弱就该早点买保险啊！算了，我直接开始推销了，事后记得好好感谢我哦。”§!

实际上，她本人也不知道到底会发生什么事，这样的体型她也是第一次尝试，虽然这百万倍的大小恐怕只是一根手指都可以直接点碎山脉，只是手掌下压恐怕发达的城市也会变为黄土，如果臀部从着太空落下恐怕一个逝去的城市群都将成为地下万米的遗迹。但是，对于自己再熟悉不过的呼气，此刻她却想象不到它的威力。

她深吸了一口气便创造出世人难得一见的奇观，那些笼罩城市的云朵在小人的眼皮子底下，被遮挡住天空的少女用她高挺的鼻梁下两个看不到底的牵引，如果把天空比作海洋，少女只是吸气就把整个大海吞噬，那些如鱼儿一般的云朵也逃离不了那填不满的坑洞，打着转的向着里面涌入，此前还在空中翱翔的飞机在察觉到突发情况之前，就已经和几百万加仑的空气一起被压缩到少女的鼻腔内，在旋转的气流中直接被加速度离心力绞成碎块，没有接触到少女鼻肉的机会。想从空中逃离的小人被少女无意中全灭。

原本因为少女阴云遮盖的城市，下一刻就变成了阳光明媚的晴天。透过透亮而干燥的天空，人们看到了地球上最剧烈的大气运动。

就如前面所说少女现在每一秒都再把底下这数以千万记的人们可供几个月呼吸的空气压缩到肺里，小人能观测到的地方天空都再围绕少女而旋转，那在鼻前形成的速度已经超越音速的漩涡，已经让人们产生视错觉，在他们看来那漩涡已经成为了实体，甚至认为少女直接把天空收入鼻前。等到十几秒后，人们才意识到少女正在吸气，因为少女一手造成的暴雨天灾，吓得魂飞魄散的小人们哪怕想要偷跑，在这个运输失能的城市里，也只能四处逃窜，只能无力的看着少女轻抿嘴唇，鼓成球状的脸颊提示人们少女已经完成吸气。

少女保持着微笑她并不急着呼出刚刚吸入的空气，因为一时兴起，她想再给这些可怜的人儿一点准备时间，观察人们将要采取什么动作抵御她的吐息。

慌乱的人们连常识都抛到脑后，只是一根筋的想要逃离逃离少女，大部分人第一想法竟然是跑出相对坚固的建筑，在流淌着少女口水芬芳已经化为泥水滩的街道中前进，哪怕少女及时打断了降水，现在街道上积水也有一米多深，别说逃跑有些慌乱的人们有些因为慌乱一个脚滑，整个人在水中无能的挣扎，最后只能连肚子都被少女口水撑圆的成为水上漂尸，让这条路更加难走，还有不小人被这看不见底的河流的暗流裹挟，被卷入排水系统中降低了着低效的排水系统，那一点点效率，那些被水流引出的各色小虫，腐臭的动物尸体，残留的各色尖锐物品，哪怕那些极幸运的小人走上几步都浑身是伤，一时间哀嚎不断。

但就算跑又有什么用？就算逃离出这个城市也无法断定安全无虑——因为少女的樱唇，光是长度就达到了公里级，加上有着足够的距离扩散恐怕整个大陆都要受影响吧。当然，另外一些小人，并不像大多数人一样在拥挤的道路上逃窜，而是躲进了地下室与建筑中。
translation:
§r"Looks delicious..."§!

Seeing the buildings, the maiden swallowed. But this was Exhale Insurance. She patted her cheeks to focus.

§r"Hello everyone, I'm the salesperson for [branch_office_owner.GetName]. Please buy our Exhale Insurance."§!

Her voice was clear, but people fled in panic. Looking up, they saw her lips open, dispersing clouds for thousands of miles. A breath passed through the atmosphere, bringing a heatwave and a pleasant scent. The moisture condensed on glass, equal to a month's rainfall. It rained heavily.

The flood rose. Drainage failed. She noticed.

§r"Clouds blocking the view. Why live on such a planet? You're so weak, just buy insurance! Fine, I'll start the pitch. Thank me later."§!

She took a deep breath. Clouds were sucked into her nostrils like fish into a whirlpool. Planes were compressed into her nose and destroyed.

The sky cleared. She was inhaling the air people needed for months every second. A supersonic vortex formed at her nose. People panicked, running through saliva-muddy streets. Corpses floated. The sewers backed up.

Running was useless. Her lips were kilometers long.

销售员小姐脱下了脚上的高跟鞋，轻轻的踩在松软的土地上，巨大的双足如同一座山脉一般矗立在[event_target:gts_ultra_company_target.GetName]的首府旁，黑丝间积攒的气味在微风的作用下一点点的飘入城市之中。

translation:

Her colossal feet stood like a mountain range beside the capital of [event_target:gts_ultra_company_target.GetName]. The scent accumulated in her black silk stockings drifted into the city with the breeze, causing a commotion among the tinies. Ah, it seems they are sensible after all—if they had just done this earlier, none of this would have happened.

§r“这么说来，我怎么玩都没关系咯？难得的好事啊。”§!千海一边想象着，一边穿起了轻薄的白丝，向着自己的小玩具处出发。

[event_target:gts_ultra_company_target.GetName]上，小人们纷纷注视着这天外来客，虽然先前已经收到了保险公司的警告，但真当千海上下打量起这颗小小的星球后，小人们才真正意识到自己的渺小。或许到了这时，小人们会后悔与自己的毁约？不过现在后悔已经来不及了，千海已经用双足包裹住了这颗小小的星球，随着白色的巨型山峰落地，大地被撞得四分五裂，岩浆喷涌，大气层在两座超大山峰的作用下被扯得稀碎，小人们赖以生存的空气也纷纷被恶臭的气味所取代，两座最高山峰随意的躺在星球上，不断的散发出闷热的臭气和含着费洛蒙的水蒸气，整个星球的生态，仅仅是在千海的第一轮攻势下，就被完全瓦解了。

§r“小星球还是这么软，松松的泥土和可怜的小人，这脚感真棒啊”。§!

白色的山脉感受着身下的大地，几座附属的小山也相互搓了搓，感受着身下美妙的质地。小山们贪婪的挪动着，将触碰到的一切都碾作齑粉，没有什么能阻挡他们，那些古老的山脉不行，那些小人的破烂科技更不行。似乎是熟悉了这颗星球的硬度，千海一点点的搓动着脚下的星球，白丝在脏兮兮的土球上蹭来蹭去，脏兮兮的土和臭烘烘的汗混合在了一起，原本看起来洁白如雪的白丝，已经变得不成样子。

original: 很遗憾，这个文明拒绝了我们的保险服务。因此，我们派出了两位体型不同的巨娘前往[target.capital_scope.GetName]，让她们亲自为那颗行星上灰尘一般的生物们示范一下，巨娘的小物件所带来的压迫感。\n\n在第一次示范中，一位数万米大小的少女首先降临到了[target.capital_scope.GetName]表面上一座繁华的都市旁边，并随手褪下了自己所佩戴的手套丢进了城市之中，庞大的黑色皮革笼罩了小小的城市的上空，紧随而来的黑暗瞬间使城市里的[target.GetSpeciesAdj]们陷入了深深的恐慌。轰然落地的巨大黑色手套在一瞬间之内就碾碎了[target.GetSpeciesAdj]们引以为傲的中心城区，这一庞然大物所掀起的飓风又毁灭了城市周边的数座菌落一般的小镇与村庄。根据我们的探测器传来的数据，仅仅是这位少女手套的其中一根指套就已经造成了数千万只小人的伤亡，以及一同被丝线碾碎的星球陆军的覆灭。我们预期的目标已经达成，一只手套所带来的毁灭已经让[target.GetSpeciesAdj]们明白了巨娘的威压。不过，为了避免残余的小人寄生在指缝之间，在第二次示范开始之前，我们已经建议那位少女清洗一下自己的手套。
translation:
Unfortunately, this civilization rejected our insurance services. Therefore, we dispatched two Giantesses of different sizes to [target.capital_scope.GetName], allowing them to personally demonstrate to the dust-like creatures on that planet the oppressive force brought by a Giantess's small accessories.

In the first demonstration, a Giantess standing tens of thousands of meters tall took off the high heels on her feet and the panties from her body, tossing them onto the surface of this planet. Those massive panties, like a dark cloud blotting out the sun, completely enveloped the largest city on [target.capital_scope.GetName] in their shadow. The residual sweat and bodily fluids mixed on the panties produced a suffocatingly rich odor, causing millions of [target.GetSpeciesAdj] to lose consciousness on the spot. Immediately after, the enormous high heel plummeted from the sky, directly crushing another city into a bottomless crater and triggering violent global earthquakes.

The inhabitants of [target.capital_scope.GetName] finally realized their insignificance, but for us, the demonstration had only just begun. Having witnessed that small accessories casually discarded by a Giantess could inflict such horrific destruction, the [target.GetSpeciesAdj] who survived were plunged into deep despair; their civilization was as fragile before a Giantess as a toy in a child's hands. And this was merely the beginning—an even more terrifying catastrophe awaited them...

original: 非常好，准备第二次示范把
translation: Very good, prepare the second demonstration.

original:
我们的工作人员很快就已经就位，对[target.capital_scope.GetName]的第二次示范已经准备完成。在[target.capital_scope.GetName]上的万米级巨娘撤离之后，另一位体型已经达到了数亿米，即已经远远大于那颗行星的体积的巨娘来到了渺小的星球旁边，伸出了一根手指，缓缓地褪下了自己黑丝巨足上套着的黑色皮鞋，并将其移动到了星球上空。

一阵难以想象的足汗气息一瞬间就席卷了这颗星球的表面，少女的足味粗暴地从深渊一般的鞋口中奔涌而出，并几乎完全替换了这颗星球上的大气层，伴随而来的足汗暴雨以及足垢陨石雨冲刷着这颗星球上的地貌，同时粉碎着[target.GetSpeciesAdj]的一座座城市与数不清的个体。

很快，几片全新的足汗海洋以及足垢山峰就已经在这颗星球上形成，溺死在其中或是被压在污垢下方的[target.GetSpeciesAdj]数不胜数。通过我们预先埋藏在地表上的数架摄影机显示，仅仅是少女鞋中滴出的一滴汗液就已经几乎彻底摧毁了[target.GetSpeciesAdj]们的国度，更不用说仍然悬在星球上空的，几乎可以容纳这个文明全员移民的小皮鞋了。
translation:
Our personnel were quickly in position, and the second demonstration for [target.capital_scope.GetName] was ready. After the 10,000-meter-tall Giantess on [target.capital_scope.GetName] withdrew, another Giantess whose size reached hundreds of millions of meters—far exceeding that of a planet—appeared in orbit around [target.capital_scope.GetName]. She did not even need to personally descend upon the world; she merely took off a shoe and suspended it above the atmosphere of [target.capital_scope.GetName]. The colossal shadow cast by that shoe instantly plunged the entire planet into eternal darkness.

The terrifying heat and pungent foot odor emanating from the sole alone devastated the planet's ecosystem as it penetrated the atmosphere. The Giantess seemed to find it amusing; using a toe even larger than planetary mountain ranges, she playfully scraped the surface of the planet a few times. Each seemingly casual touch triggered global tectonic fractures and tsunamis tens of thousands of meters high. Cities turned to dust under the crushing force, the crust fractured like an eggshell beneath her toe, and hundreds of millions of [target.GetSpeciesAdj] were wiped out in despair.

Finally, satisfied, the Giantess withdrew her toe and put her shoe back on, leaving the star system as if she had merely kicked away an insignificant pebble by the roadside. Behind her, the once-bustling [target.capital_scope.GetName] was reduced to a lifeless wasteland; the planet's surface was ripped apart by crisscrossing chasms, reeking of a scorched scent mixed with foot sweat. All traces of civilization were completely erased in this destructive demonstration, leaving only desolate geological ruins in space silently recounting the horrific catastrophe that had befell the planet.

original: 当然，由于[target.capital_scope.GetName]的生命已经所剩无几，侥幸活下来的[target.GetSpeciesAdj]也已经在巨娘庞大的身躯下彻底崩溃，沦为了只能依靠巨娘的足汗才能够存活的寄生微生物，因此已经不再具有购买我们的保险业务的条件。\n\n因此，我们最终还是怜悯地稍微恢复了那颗星球的生态系统，重新留下了一些在巨娘的体液海洋里保留了些许神志的[target.GetSpeciesAdj]个体之后撤离了那里。同时，由于第二次示范中那位巨娘并未按照要求示范§Y巨娘随身物品险§!，而是示范了我们的另一个险种§Y巨娘足汗险§!，因此我们也对她作出了一些惩罚。
translation: Of course, since virtually no life remained on [target.capital_scope.GetName], the few [target.GetSpeciesAdj] who survived had completely broken down under the Giantess's colossal body, reduced to parasitic microorganisms that could only survive by relying on her foot sweat, and thus no longer possessed the ability to purchase insurance. original:
在§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!的居民们已经开始庆祝一年一度的愚人节活动，各种各样的玩笑话，恶作剧，不断刷新着人们的想象力。
但是所有人都没有想到的是，伊莉雅丝菲尔小姐也想加入这场欢乐盛况，而星球表面的人还浑然不知，只有远处航行的星际飞船，和空间站观测到了这一幕。
她巨大的身躯就这样毫无征兆地出现在了星球旁。
“呀？大家看上去很开心呢，不介意让我也加入吧？” 
少女活泼的声音，通过魔力传递到每个人耳中。也许没有人知道她接下来想要做什么。
“不给糖就捣蛋，啊对了，今天好像不是万圣节呢？那是不是……”
像是假装想起来了，伊莉雅沉默了片刻，又露出一个笑容。
“嘛，总之快点把糖果交出来哦” 
“糖果，我们上哪去找糖果？” 
众人皆是无语。
“哎？没有吗？那就把大家当成糖果吃掉好啦” 
略带失望的表情，但是随即伊莉雅坏笑地张开嘴，指尖搭在星球上，当然也没有忘记使用魔法保护，避免星球被自己碰碎掉。
“啊啊啊！” 
一阵惊恐的声音，所有人开始拼了命地逃窜，各种交通工具都在星球表面全速奔驰，只为了找到最近的星舰，从而逃亡，但很显然这么短的时间完全不够。
“大家都要被伊莉雅吃掉啦，感觉有点羞耻呢” 
伴随着那活泼的声音，在绝望的目光中，白皙的手指将星球推入口中，似乎马上就要落在舌头上面。
当然我们的飞船从太空视角可以看到，也许是因为口中含着无数生命的奇妙感觉，让伊莉雅小姐不由地面色通红，露出一个带着些许恶作剧意味的笑容。搭着地球的手也微微颤抖。
“嘻嘻，吓到大家了吗？伊莉雅才不会做这种事情呢，那样就变成坏孩子啦。” 
但是少女的动作就在最后一步戛然而止，预想中恐怖的画面没有发生，巨大的手指突然改变了方向，将星球又从嘴里推了出来。
“星球上的的大家，愚人节快乐呦！” 
露出恶作剧得逞的笑容，伊莉雅用调皮的声音向着星球招手。
嗯，这或许会成为这个星球历史上最大的恶作剧。
translation: The residents of §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! have begun celebrating their annual April Fool's Day activities. Various jokes and pranks are constantly pushing the limits of their imagination.\\nBut what no one expected was that Ms. Illyasviel also wanted to join this joyful occasion. While the people on the surface were still oblivious, only interstellar ships and space stations in the distance observed the scene.\\nHer massive body appeared next to the planet without any warning.\\n“Ah? Everyone looks so happy, you don't mind if I join too?”\\nThe girl's lively voice reached everyone's ears through magic. No one knew what she intended to do next.\\n“Trick or treat... ah wait, today isn't Halloween, is it? Then maybe...”\\nAs if pretending to remember, Illyasviel fell silent for a moment before flashing another smile.\\n“Anyway, hurry up and hand over the candy.”\\n“Candy? Where are we supposed to find candy?”\\nEveryone was speechless.\\n“Eh? There isn't any? Then I’ll just eat everyone as candy.”\\nWith a look of slight disappointment, Illyasviel then gave a mischievous grin and opened her mouth, her fingertip resting on the planet—not forgetting to use protective magic to keep the planet from being crushed.\\n“Aaaaah!”\\nA wave of terrified screams erupted as everyone began fleeing for their lives. All sorts of vehicles raced across the planet's surface to find the nearest starship for evacuation, but clearly, there wasn't enough time.\\n“Everyone is going to be eaten by Illya, feels a bit embarrassing,”\\nAccompanying that lively voice, and under desperate gazes, her white fingers pushed the planet toward her mouth, seemingly about to land on her tongue.\\nFrom a space perspective, our ships could see Ms. Illyasviel turning red, perhaps due to the wonderful sensation of holding countless lives in her mouth, wearing a smile filled with mischief. The hand holding the planet trembled slightly.\\n“Heehee, did I scare everyone? Illya wouldn't do such a thing, that would make me a bad girl.”\\nBut the girl's actions stopped at the final step. The expected horror didn't happen; her giant fingers suddenly changed direction and pushed the planet back out of her mouth.\\n“Happy April Fool's Day to everyone on the planet!”\\nWaving at the planet with a playful voice and a grin of a successful prank.\\nYes, this will likely become the greatest prank in the planet's history.

original:
魔力小行星即将命中§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!但我们的武器尚未准备就绪，危机时刻，我们突然检测到一个高能反应，一个巨大的紫色物体在以更快的速度靠近，就像一艘巨型战舰，拖着明亮的轨迹。
“记得应该是在这附近有一颗星球的，在哪里呢？唔，该不会迷路了吧” 
夹杂着一丝慌乱的声音，刚好停在了星球和小行星中间，是一位身穿紫色法袍的天体级少女。原来是加拉哈德小姐。她在太空中左顾右盼，寻找着目标。但她似乎没有发现，此时§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!就在她旁边，甚至与她法袍飘动的下摆擦肩而过。
幸运的是这预想中可怕的事情并没有发生。否则这可能会演变成一场更大的灾难，此时§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!的居民只能看到少女那被深紫色过膝袜包裹的大腿，甚至还有一小部分，藏在紫色裙底下的奇妙风光。
“呀？这是……小石头？” 
刚好抬起头，少女注意到了面前的小行星，带着疑惑的表情将脸凑近，仔细打量了一番，然后又好奇地伸出手掌，蓝色的小行星在她手中就像一颗弹珠一样小巧，被轻易捏住。
“好像有很强烈的能量波动，并不像是天然的呢？” 
“非常感谢，加拉哈德小姐，如果让这颗小行星撞上我们的星球……那就危险了” 
“到底是怎么回事呢？” 
“是这样……有个法师的实验出了意外……”
经过一番简单的解释，加拉哈德小姐了解了原因。
“哎，是这样吗？那我帮你们解决掉好啦，你们也真是的，做实验居然差点把自己的星球毁了” 
看着指尖的小行星，加拉哈德嘟囔着最，手指微微用力，就将其捏碎，变成了大量更加微小的碎屑。
“话说，你们的星球到底在哪呢？我怎么没看到” 
“那个，这么说可能有点失礼，请您把头低下，我们在您下面” 
“呜哇！？原来你们在这里呀……因为太小了刚刚没发现” 
低头望去，加拉哈德小姐终于发现了在她身下的小小星球。害羞地涨红了脸，下意识伸手去遮，而这也导致她的衣裙更加剧烈的晃动起来，好像随时可能撞到星球上。
“啊啊啊！请您小心一点，我们的小星球可经不住您的力量” 
§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!刚刚劫后余生的居民，还未来得及开始庆祝，就再次迎来更大的危险。
“哇，对不起，对不起啦！” 
通讯传来的尖叫让加拉哈德连忙道歉。拉开距离，控制着自己的身体将那张可爱的面庞对准星球，表情认真却又带着惊慌，语速不受控制的加快。
“总之你们下次也小心一点，不要再做这么危险的实验啦，那个……我先走啦，再见” 
留下最后一句提醒，这位天体级少女仓皇而逃，离开了这个星系。§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!终于恢复了往日的和平，居民们举行了盛大的庆祝活动。也许这次事件应该会让那些疯狂的法师得到教训，少做一些危险的实验。
经过探查，我们发现这颗小行星的是由高浓度的魔力结晶构成，哪怕是一些边角料都可以作为优秀的能源供应。我们已尽可能将这些优质资源回收。
translation:
The Magic Asteroid was about to strike §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!, but our defenses were not yet ready. In that moment of crisis, we detected a high-energy signature—a massive purple entity approaching at blinding speed, like a colossal battleship trailing a luminous wake.
“I recall there being a planet around here; where is it? Hmm, could I be lost?”
A slightly panicked voice crackled as she halted squarely between §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! and the asteroid. It was Miss Galahad, now at celestial scale in her purple robes. She scanned space, searching, seemingly unaware that §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! was right beside her—the hem of her robes even brushed past our atmosphere.
Mercifully, the collision we feared did not occur, though it could have easily become an even greater catastrophe. For those on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!, the sky was filled by her thighs in deep purple stockings, with even a hint of the wondrous sights beneath her skirt visible in the cosmic distance.
“Ah? Is this... a pebble?”
Glancing up, the girl noticed the asteroid. With a puzzled look, she leaned in, examining it closely before curiously reaching out. In her palm, the blue asteroid was no larger than a marble, easily pinched between her fingers.
“There's a very intense energy aura here; it doesn't seem natural, does it?”
“Heartfelt thanks, Miss Galahad. Had that asteroid struck us... it would have been dire.”
“What's going on here?”
“Well... a mage's experiment Went somewhat awry...”
After a brief explanation, Miss Galahad understood.
“Oh, is that so? I'll solve it for you then. You really shouldn't be so careless—almost destroying your own planet with an experiment!”
With a slight pout, she applied a fraction of her strength, crushing the asteroid between her fingertips into a cloud of micro-debris.
“By the way, where IS your planet? I don't see it anywhere.”
“Um, this might be a bit awkward, but... please look down. We are beneath you.”
“Uwaa!? You were there the whole time? You're so small I didn't even notice!”
Looking down, Miss Galahad finally saw the tiny sphere below. Her face flushed a deep crimson as she instinctively reached to cover herself—a move that caused her dress to sway violently, nearly brushing against the planet.
“Wait! Please be careful! Our little world can't take much of that!”
The survivors on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! found themselves in a new, even larger danger before they could celebrate their salvation.
“Wah! Sorry, I'm so sorry!”
The frantic warning made Galahad apologize profusely. She backed away, bringing her cute, panicked face into view as she spoke with rapid-fire speed.
“Just... be more careful next time! No more dangerous experiments! Um... I have to go now! Goodbye!”
With one last warning, the celestial girl fled in a flurry of purple, leaving the system behind. Peace finally returned to §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!, and the people celebrated with a grand festival. Perhaps this close call will teach those mad mages to be more cautious.
Surveys confirm the asteroid was composed of concentrated mana crystals. Even the remnants will serve as an excellent energy source. We have salvaged as much as possible.
